<button disabled={design || state.status !== "ready"} onClick={() => run(async () => { const url = navigation.shareUrl(); await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url); setError("已复制当前视点与固定项目修订地址"); }) } > 分享当前视点 </button>
<button disabled={!state.history.length || design} onClick={() => run(() => navigation.back())} > 返回 </button>

<button key={n.id} aria-current={n.id === state.nodeId ? "location" : undefined} disabled={design || state.status === "loading"} onClick={() => run(() => navigation.navigate(n.id))} > <RuntimeAssetImage runtime={runtime}
<button key={link.id} disabled={design || state.status === "loading"} onClick={() => run(() => navigation.followLink(link.id))} > 前往 {graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === link.toNodeId)?.name} </button>
<button disabled={design || index <= 0} onClick={() => run(() => navigation.navigate(graph.nodes[index - 1].id)) } > 上一站 </button>
<button disabled={design || index >= graph.nodes.length - 1} onClick={() => run(() => navigation.navigate(graph.nodes[index + 1].id)) } > 下一站 </button>
<button disabled={design} onClick={() => run(() => navigation.startRoute(routeId || graph.routes[0].id)) } > 自动导览 </button>
<button disabled={disabled} onClick={()=>action('ViewMode','',{mode:state.viewMode==='first'?'third':'first'})}>{state.viewMode==='first'?'切换第三人称':'切换第一人称'}</button>
<button disabled={design} style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", color: "inherit", background: "transparent", border: 0, font: "inherit", }} onClick={() => invoke()} > {text} </button>
<button key={item.id} disabled={design} onClick={() => { const action = createAction("OpenContent"); action.targetId = item.id; context.run(action); }} > {item.title} </button>
